filters.title: Objective
filters.order_by: CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(`abbr`,'.',1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT(`abbr`,'.0.0'),'.',2),'.',-1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT(`abbr`,'.0.0'),'.',3),'.',-1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, `abbr` asc

filters.title: Programme
filters.order_by: CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(`abbr`,'.',1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT(`abbr`,'.0.0'),'.',2),'.',-1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT(`abbr`,'.0.0'),'.',3),'.',-1) AS UNSIGNED) asc, `abbr` asc
filters._note: narrow_by names the parent filter (the Objective box) and parent_field the programme's column holding its id: the box lists only the chosen objective's programmes - or, with only a goal chosen, that goal's, since custom.js follows the chain - and clears itself when either changes.
